title: What If It Rained Every Day Everywhere?
yt_title: What If It Rained EVERY SINGLE DAY Everywhere? 🌧️ #shorts
description: Imagine a world where the rain never stops falling on any continent. Explore the crazy consequences of non-stop rain on Parallel Earth!
next_topic: What if there was no night?

scenes.bg: heavy rain falling on city street
head: WHAT IF IT
*RAINED*
EVERY DAY?

lines.text: Para! What if it rained every day everywhere?
I live in that world, Blue! Grab your umbrella and let me show you!
No sunshine at all? My laundry will never dry!
Welcome to my world! Umbrellas and puddles everywhere.
With non-stop rain, rivers overflow fast, flooding cities and saturating all soil.
If water rises, I will hide behind the Moon!
Crops rot in soggy ground without sunlight, causing massive global food shortages.
No crops? Does that mean no snacks or pizza?
Humidity hits one hundred percent constantly. Wooden houses rot and metal rusts quickly.
I am sweating just thinking about permanent humidity!
Amphibians thrive! Frogs and rainforest plants take over every continent.
Are frogs the boss now? Can I get Wi-Fi in frog cities?
Thick clouds block ninety percent of sunlight, turning Earth chilly and gloomy.
Cold rain every day sounds like a nightmare!

scenes.big: Mawsynram gets 11,870 mm of rain yearly!
scenes.sublabel: The wettest place on planet Earth
head: THE WETTEST
*PLACE ON EARTH*

lines.text: On your Earth, Mawsynram in India gets nearly twelve meters of rain yearly!
Twelve meters? That is taller than a three-story house!
While deserts get almost nothing, Mawsynram pours non-stop!
Nature really loves showing off her water!
Next time, Blue, I will show you a world where there is no night!
Welcome to Parallel Earth!
Would you pick endless rain, or endless drought? Comment below!
